The '''''P1''''' was a [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]]. Before the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Starship|ship]] was sent by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] to reinforce [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]]'s [[Phoenix Cell|unit]] of the rebellion along with two other Hammerheads, the ''[[P2]]'' and ''[[P3]]''. The three ships were stolen by one of Sato's sub-units, the [[Spectres]], during a [[Mission on Lothal|raid]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Princess on Lothal" /> When part of [[Phoenix Cell]], it was one of the few ships to escape the disastrous [[Battle of Atollon]], where its sister ship ''P2'' was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire]], along with many other ships.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''P1'' first appeared in "[[A Princess on Lothal]]," the mid-season premier of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' TV series aired on [[Disney XD]] [[January 20]], [[2016]].<ref name="Leia Scoop">{{WebCite|url=https://www.tvinsider.com/64379/star-wars-rebels-scoop-princess-leia-set-to-appear-on-the-disney-xd-animated-series|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Scoop: Princess Leia Set to Appear on the Disney XD Animated Series|author=Sands, Rich|date=2016-01-11|work=TV Insider|archivedate=20180831104309}}</ref> It was first identified in the corresponding episode guide on [[StarWars.com]], along with Hammerhead corvettes ''P2'' and ''P3''.<ref name="APOL Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-episode-guide|text="A Princess on Lothal" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' later identified the three corvettes featured in "A Princess on Lothal" as ''[[Lightmaker]]'', ''Duchess Senna'', and ''Amity's Arrow''.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>

Save for the lack of the [[Aurebesh]] characters "''P1''" on the film's model,<ref name="APOL Episode Guide" /> the markings of ''P1'' match that of the ''Sphyrna''-class corvette featured in the late-2016 [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Anthology'' film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> which was also identified as the ''Lightmaker'' by the film's [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|novelization]].<ref name="Rogue One novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref> However, any correspondence between the three corvettes named in ''The Rebel Files'' and the three corvettes in "A Princess on Lothal" has not been acknowledged by any official source to date.
